targets.title: Personalized Glucose Targets
targets.subtitle: Target ranges by measurement context and clinician approval status
targets.educationalNotice: Important Note: Initial values of 80–130 mg/dL before meals and below 180 mg/dL 1–2 hours after meals are educational reference values only. They are marked as unconfirmed until reviewed and approved by Mom's doctor.

alerts.hypo1515Title: Educational 15-15 Rule for Conscious Low Blood Sugar
alerts.hypo1515Step1: 1. Take 15 grams of fast-acting sugar immediately (e.g. 1/2 cup fruit juice or 3-4 candies).
alerts.hypo1515Step3: 3. Re-test blood sugar. If still below 70 mg/dL, repeat with another 15g.
alerts.unconsciousWarning: ⚠️ If unconscious or unable to swallow: DO NOT give food or liquids by mouth! Call emergency medical services (119 / hospital) immediately!
